title: 第9章 伏魔十三掌第10章 萧月寒
content_zh:
呼！
呼！
简朴的房间之中，苏辰光着上半身，露出古铜色的皮肤，虎虎生风的施展一套掌法。
因为不断的修炼，苏辰的身体上已然满是汗水，一条短裤完全被打湿，贴在身上。
每轰出一掌，便是凝聚一股凌厉的掌风，在那掌风之下，房间中的窗帘都被吹得猎猎作响。
“呼！”
苏辰长长吐了一口气，停了下来，拿出毛巾，擦了擦身上的汗水。
“这《伏魔十三掌》武技果然非同小可，我这才修炼了七八天，威力就已经超过了我之前修炼的灵级下品武技！”
苏辰脸上满是喜色。
《伏魔十三掌》，便是那残缺武技。
这武技本是缺少了开头的一掌，因此无法修炼，只不过梦星从那之后的十二掌推算出前面一掌。
因此，这《伏魔十三掌》，便成为了真正的灵级上品武技。
至于这武技的名字，却是梦星起的。
一连十日时间，苏辰一是炼化那聚元丹，二是承受梦星释放的重力，三便是修炼这《伏魔十三掌》。
三管齐下，苏辰的实力也是迅速提升，不但跨入了四级武徒的境界，而且战力也大大增强。
苏辰感觉现在的自己，面对七级武徒也有的一战。
梦星的声音在苏辰脑海之中响起：“你才将这武技修炼到了这武技的三成火候，竟然就沾沾自喜了。”
“三成火候？”
苏辰微微吃了一惊。
“我只给你施展一遍，你仔细看好，至于能收获多少，就看你自己的悟性了。”

冷淡的声音响起，那梦星如梦似幻的身影，也是出现在苏辰身前。
苏辰神色凝重，仔细的盯着梦星。
梦星的实力深不可测，对武技的领悟，自然也不是寻常人可比的。
梦星淡然的站在苏辰面前，那一张绝美的脸如同万年寒冰一般：“我将这掌法命名为《伏魔十三掌》，并不仅仅是为了听上去有气势，而是这武技必须要有降妖伏魔的气势！”
“掌法，讲究一往无前！
一掌挥出，便所向披靡！”
“你看好了！”
在苏辰的注视之下，梦星的身形动了，一掌掌挥舞出来。
苏辰瞪大了眼睛，不敢错过任何一个细节。
苏辰能感觉到，梦星施展起这《伏魔十三掌》，与自己施展起来看似没有任何不同，不但不比自己凌厉，反而好像是“慢”
了一些。
但梦星的每一掌挥出，都有一种重如山岳的感觉。
苏辰丝毫不怀疑，这一掌轰在自己身上，足以让自己粉身碎骨。
片刻之后，梦星将十三掌施展完毕，停了下来，凝视苏辰：“懂了没有？”
“没有。”
苏辰毫不犹豫的摇头。
梦星淡然道：“没懂便对了，你若是说懂了，我少不了训斥你一番，你可以慢慢体悟我的掌法，若是能悟透，这《伏魔十三掌》你便能掌握了。”

In the simple room, Su Chen bare his upper body, revealing his bronze skin, and performed a set of palm techniques vigorously.
Due to continuous practice, Su Chen's body was covered with sweat, and a pair of shorts were completely wet and stuck to his body.
Every time a palm is struck, a sharp palm wind gathers. Under the palm wind, the curtains in the room are blown loudly.
"Phew!"
Su Chen took a long breath, stopped, took out a towel, and wiped the sweat from his body.
"This "Thirteen Palms of Subduing Demons" martial skill is indeed extraordinary. I have only practiced it for seven or eight days, and it is already more powerful than the low-grade spirit-level martial arts I practiced before!"
Su Chen's face was full of joy.
"Thirteen Palms for Conquering Demons" is the incomplete martial arts.
This martial skill originally lacked the first palm, so it could not be practiced, but Mengxing calculated the previous palm from the twelve palms after that.
Therefore, this "Thirteen Palms of Subduing Demons" has become a truly high-grade spiritual martial art.
As for the name of this martial art, it was Mengxing who came up with it.
For ten consecutive days, Su Chen first refined the Yuan Gathering Pill, secondly withstood the gravity released by Mengxing, and thirdly practiced the "Thirteen Palms of Conquering Demons".
With the three-pronged approach, Su Chen's strength also improved rapidly. Not only did he enter the realm of a fourth-level warrior, but his combat power was also greatly enhanced.
Su Chen felt that he was now facing a battle with a seventh-level warrior.
Mengxing's voice rang in Su Chen's mind: "You have just practiced this martial skill to 30% of the level, and you are actually complacent."
"Thirty percent heat?"
Su Chen was slightly surprised.
"I'll only use it once for you. Watch it carefully. How much you can gain depends on your own understanding."
A cold voice sounded, and the dreamlike figure of Mengxing also appeared in front of Su Chen.
Su Chen looked solemn and stared at Mengxing carefully.
Mengxing's strength is unfathomable, and his understanding of martial arts is naturally unmatched by ordinary people.
Mengxing stood in front of Su Chen calmly, her beautiful face as cold as ten thousand years of ice: "I named this palm technique "Thirteen Palms of Conquering Demons" not just to sound powerful, but this martial art must have the momentum of subduing demons!"
“The palm technique emphasizes moving forward without hesitation!
With one wave of his palm, he is invincible! "
"You watch it!"
Under Su Chen's gaze, Mengxing's figure moved and waved out a palm.
Su Chen's eyes widened, not daring to miss any detail.
Su Chen could feel that when Mengxing used the "Thirteen Palms to Conquer Demons", it seemed to be no different from when he used it. Not only was it not more powerful than him, but it seemed to be "slower".
Some.
But every time Mengxing swung his palm, there was a feeling as heavy as a mountain.
Su Chen had no doubt that the palm hitting him was enough to shatter him into pieces.
After a while, Mengxing finished using the thirteen palms, stopped, and stared at Su Chen: "Do you understand?"
"No."
Su Chen shook his head without hesitation.
Mengxing said calmly: "It's okay if you don't understand. If you say you understand, I will reprimand you. You can slowly understand my palm skills. If you can understand them thoroughly, you can master the "Thirteen Palms for Conquering Demons"."
